clueSu: Kadaharan tina tipung béas nu dibeuleum dina citakan taneuh liat.
clueEn: Traditional rice flour pancake baked in a clay mold.
trivia: Surabi is famous in Bandung and served either sweet with palm sugar syrup (kinca) or savory with spicy fermented oncom.

clueSu: Sampeu nu difermentasi maké ragi nepi ka amis tur empuk, has ti Bandung.
clueEn: Sweet fermented cassava, an iconic delicacy from Bandung.
trivia: Unlike Javanese tape, Peuyeum Bandung is drier and often hung in woven bamboo baskets at souvenir shops.

clueSu: Singgetan tina 'dicocol enak', peuyeum dibeuleum tuluy dicocol kana gula beureum jeung kalapa.
clueEn: Grilled fermented cassava dipped in melted palm sugar and grated coconut.
trivia: Created in Bandung in 1930 by Aki Murdi, 'Colenak' is a portmanteau of 'dicocol enak' (tasty when dipped).

clueSu: Sayuran kulub nu digalokeun jeung sambel suuk maké cikur.
clueEn: Boiled vegetables tossed in a rich peanut sauce infused with aromatic ginger (cikur).
trivia: Loték is similar to Gado-gado, but its signature flavor comes from fresh cikur (kaempferia galanga) ground into the peanut sauce.

clueSu: Sayuran atah saperti bonténg, engkol, jeung kacang panjang nu maké sambel suuk.
clueEn: Raw crunchy vegetable salad dressed in spicy cikur peanut sauce.
trivia: Unlike Loték, all vegetables in Karedok are served completely raw and fresh, giving it a crisp texture.

clueSu: Goréngan tina parud sampeu nu jerona dieusian sambel oncom lada.
clueEn: Crispy grated cassava fritter stuffed with spicy fermented oncom.
trivia: 'Combro' stands for 'oncom di jero' (oncom inside) in Sundanese!

clueSu: Goréngan tina parud sampeu nu jerona dieusian gula beureum nepi ka lééh.
clueEn: Sweet grated cassava fritter filled with melted palm sugar.
trivia: 'Misro' stands for 'amis di jero' (sweet inside)—the sweet twin of Combro!

clueSu: Kadaharan lada has Bandung tina kurupuk baseuh nu dimasak maké cikur jeung endog.
clueEn: Spicy savory dish made from softened crackers simmered with cikur, garlic, and egg.
trivia: Seblak's unmistakable aroma comes from cikur (kencur) and fiery bird's eye chilies.

clueSu: Singgetan tina Baso Tahu Goréng, didahar maké sambel suuk jeung kécap.
clueEn: Fried fish meatballs and tofu served with rich peanut sauce and sweet soy sauce.
trivia: Invented in Bandung in the 1970s by Haji Isan, Batagor is now beloved across all of Indonesia.

clueSu: Buleudan leutik tina aci nu dicolok maké tusuk saté jeung sambel suuk.
clueEn: Chewy tapioca balls skewered on a stick with peanut sauce ('aci dicolok').
trivia: Sundanese street snacks love acronyms: Cilok = 'aci dicolok' (skewered tapioca)!

clueSu: Inuman haneut tina jahé, gula beureum, jeung rempah pikeun ngahaneutan awak.
clueEn: Traditional hot spiced ginger and palm sugar drink from the Sundanese highlands.
trivia: Perfect for chilly nights in Lembang or Ciwidey, Bandrek often includes strips of young coconut.

clueSu: Inuman haneut amis tina cipati (santen), gula kawung, jeung daun pandan.
clueEn: Warm sweet beverage made from coconut milk, palm sugar, and pandan leaves.
trivia: Traditionally sold from pushcarts alongside boiled peanuts, boiled bananas, and steamed sweet potatoes.

clueSu: Sangu haneut nu ditutug (diaduk) jeung oncom beuleum has Tasikmalaya.
clueEn: Steamed rice pounded and mixed with roasted spiced oncom, a specialty of Tasikmalaya.
trivia: Often served wrapped in banana leaves with fried chicken, salted fish, and fresh lalab.

clueSu: Daging sapi nu digebug nepi ka empuk tuluy digoréng maké bungbu amis gurih.
clueEn: Tenderized, braised, and lightly fried sweet-savory beef slices.
trivia: Also known as Empal Gepuk, the meat is pounded ('digepuk') so spices soak deep into every fiber.

clueSu: Alat musik tradisional tina awi nu disada lamun dioyagkeun.
clueEn: Traditional bamboo musical instrument played by shaking it.
trivia: Recognized by UNESCO as Masterpiece of Oral and Intangible Heritage of Humanity, each Angklung plays a single note.

clueSu: Pakarang pusaka has tatar Sunda nu bentukna melengkung artistik.
clueEn: Sacred traditional heirloom blade of the Sundanese people with a distinctive curved silhouette.
trivia: Dating back to the Pajajaran Kingdom era, the Kujang symbolizes courage, protection, and harmony with nature.

clueSu: Kasenian bonéka kayu nu dipaénkeun ku dalang, tokoh populérna nyaéta Cépot.
clueEn: Traditional three-dimensional wooden rod puppet theater narrated by a dalang.
trivia: Astrajingga (Si Cépot) is the most beloved clown-servant character in Sundanese Wayang Golek.

clueSu: Paduan musik petik tina kacapi jeung tiupan suling awi nu tiis kana haté.
clueEn: Soothing instrumental ensemble combining the Sundanese zither (kacapi) and bamboo flute (suling).
trivia: Often played in Pelog or Sorog scales, Kacapi Suling evokes the peaceful mist of Parahyangan mountains.

clueSu: Tari tradisional Sunda nu dinamis, lincah, tur dipirig ku kendang.
clueEn: Energetic, expressive traditional Sundanese dance accompanied by dynamic kendang drums.
trivia: Created in the 1970s by Gugum Gumbira, Jaipongan blends Pencak Silat movements with folk dance.

clueSu: Kasenian has Subang mangrupa bonéka singa nu dipanggul ku opat urang bari ngibing.
clueEn: Traditional Subang procession where four dancers carry an ornate lion effigy on their shoulders.
trivia: Sisingaan is traditionally performed to celebrate a boy's circumcision ceremony in Subang.

clueSu: Kain batik nu dibeungkeutkeun kana sirah lalaki Sunda minangka ciri jati diri.
clueEn: Traditional folded batik cloth headwear worn by Sundanese men.
trivia: Different folds—like Barangbang Semplak or Makuta Wangsa—carry distinct philosophical meanings.

clueSu: Imah leutik tina awi di tengah sawah atawa kebon pikeun reureuh.
clueEn: Traditional open-sided bamboo gazebo built in rice fields or gardens for resting.
trivia: Saung is a hallmark of Sundanese vernacular architecture, keeping farmers cool in the breeze.

clueSu: Alat musik tina awi saperti angklung, tapi cara maénkeunana ditakol.
clueEn: Traditional bamboo percussion instrument similar to Angklung, played by striking the tubes.
trivia: Calung performances are famous for combining lively rhythms with witty Sundanese comedy.

clueSu: Ucapan sopan pikeun ngabagéakeun sémah nu kakara datang.
clueEn: Warm polite Sundanese greeting meaning 'Welcome'.
trivia: Hospitality ('someah') is central to Sundanese culture, always starting with a warm 'Wilujeng sumping!'

clueSu: Ungkapan rasa syukur atawa tarima kasih dina basa Sunda lemes.
clueEn: Polite Sundanese expression for 'Thank you'.
trivia: The common friendly reply to 'Hatur nuhun' is 'Sami-sami' (You're welcome).

clueSu: Kalimah pananya pikeun nanyakeun kabar kaséhatan batur.
clueEn: Friendly Sundanese greeting asking 'How are you?'.
trivia: If you're doing well, you reply: 'Pangésto, damang!' (Blessedly well!).

clueSu: Sipating jalma nu ramah, bageur, tur amis budi ka saha waé.
clueEn: Warm, hospitable, friendly, and welcoming toward guests and strangers.
trivia: The famous motto 'Someah Hade ka Semah' means being kind and hospitable to all guests.

clueSu: Falsafah Sunda nu hartina silih seukeutan élmu jeung pangaweruh.
clueEn: Sundanese philosophy meaning to mutually sharpen one another's knowledge and intellect.
trivia: Part of the foundational Sundanese triad: Silih Asah, Silih Asih, Silih Asuh.

clueSu: Falsafah Sunda nu hartina silih pikanyaah jeung silih hormat sasama.
clueEn: Sundanese philosophy meaning to mutually love, care for, and respect one another.
trivia: Silih Asih encourages compassion and empathy across communities.

clueSu: Falsafah Sunda nu hartina silih jaga, silih bimbing, jeung silih raksa.
clueEn: Sundanese philosophy meaning to mutually guide, protect, and nurture each other.
trivia: Together, Silih Asah, Silih Asih, and Silih Asuh form the pillars of Sundanese social harmony.

clueSu: Kecap sipat pikeun jalma nu hadé haté, nurut, tur daék nulungan.
clueEn: Sundanese adjective meaning kind-hearted, well-behaved, and generous.
trivia: In Sundanese values, 'Cageur, Bageur, Bener, Pinter' lists the ideal virtues of a person.

clueSu: Kaayaan awak jeung pikiran nu séhat waluya teu aya panyakit.
clueEn: Healthy in both body and mind.
trivia: Cageur is the very first virtue in the Sundanese proverb 'Cageur, Bageur, Bener, Pinter'.

clueSu: Ngabogaan sikep, basa, jeung paripolah nu luyu jeung budaya Sunda.
clueEn: Embodying Sundanese language, manners, and cultural identity.
trivia: 'Urang Sunda kudu nyunda' means Sundanese people should keep their language and heritage alive.

clueSu: Dataran luhur di Jawa Kulon nu disebut ogé tempat cicingna para hyang.
clueEn: The lush mountainous highland region of West Java ('Abode of the Gods').
trivia: Priangan (Parahyangan) encompasses Bandung, Garut, Sumedang, Cianjur, and Tasikmalaya.

clueSu: Gunung di kaléreun Bandung nu bentukna siga parahu nangkub dina sasakala Sangkuriang.
clueEn: Famous stratovolcano north of Bandung shaped like an overturned boat.
trivia: According to Sundanese legend, Sangkuriang kicked his unfinished boat upside down, forming this mountain.

clueSu: Talaga kawah di Ciwidey nu caina warna bodas kahéjo-héjoan.
clueEn: Striking turquoise-white volcanic crater lake located in Ciwidey, South Bandung.
trivia: Located at 2,430 meters above sea level, its sulfur-rich water changes hue depending on sunlight and weather.

clueSu: Walungan pangpanjangna tur panggedéna di tatar Sunda (Jawa Kulon).
clueEn: The longest and largest river in West Java, vital for agriculture and hydroelectricity.
trivia: Historically, the Citarum River divided the ancient Sunda and Galuh kingdoms.

clueSu: Wewengkon tiis di suku Gunung Tangkuban Parahu nu kasohor ku susu sapi jeung kebon sayur.
clueEn: Cool highland town north of Bandung known for dairy farms, strawberries, and flower gardens.
trivia: Lembang is also home to the historic Bosscha Observatory, built in 1923.

clueSu: Wewengkon di Bandung Kidul nu pinuh ku kebon entéh, situ, jeung stroberi.
clueEn: Scenic southern Bandung highland famous for tea plantations, Situ Patenggang, and strawberries.
trivia: The misty air of Ciwidey makes it one of the top weekend nature escapes in West Java.

clueSu: Kota nu kasohor ku dodolna, domba adu, jeung Gunung Papandayan.
clueEn: Highland regency famous for Dodol sweets, Garut sheep, and Mount Papandayan.
trivia: Garut was nicknamed 'Swiss van Java' during the early 20th century for its dramatic alpine valleys.

clueSu: Kota di Priangan Wétan nu kasohor ku karajinan payung geulis, kelom geulis, jeung bordél.
clueEn: Eastern Priangan city renowned for traditional painted umbrellas (payung geulis) and embroidery.
trivia: Tasikmalaya is also the birthplace of Nasi Tutug Oncom.

clueSu: Puseur dayeuh Jawa Kulon nu katelah Kota Kembang jeung Paris van Java.
clueEn: Capital city of West Java, affectionately nicknamed 'Kota Kembang' (City of Flowers).
trivia: Surrounded by volcanic mountains, Bandung is the cultural and culinary heart of Parahyangan.
